To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) embedding based retrieval models can be trained with paragraph level pre training objectives (2) the combination of ICT, BFS and WLP pre training tasks can improve the retrieval performance significantly (3) the pre training objectives can be combined with the retrieval objective and (4) the pre training objective can be combined with a cross attention model.
the pre training tasks for embedding based retrieval are: 1) ICT, BFS and WLP are all effective; 2) ICT is more effective than WLP and BFS, and 3) WLP is less effective than BFS.

(1) the pre training tasks are the most crucial component of the embedding based retrieval model, and (2) the combination of ICT BFS and WLP pre training tasks achieves the best performance on the large scale retrieval tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and study of the pre training tasks for the Transformer models for the retrieval problem.
two aspects: (i) the design of pre training tasks for embedding based retrieval models; (ii) the study of Transformer models for retrieval.
the following three questions: (1) What are good pre training tasks for Transformer based retrieval models?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Transformer based embedding models are not necessarily better than the classic BM 25 model.
the paragraph level pre training task of BFS is the most effective one for the retrieval phase.

the Transformer based embedding model with the paragraph level pre training outperforms BM 25 in terms of both recall and precision, and the combination of pre training tasks is the best among the ones we studied.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
1) Transformer based embedding models with paragraph level pre training are a promising direction to improve the retrieval phase in the large scale query doc retrieval problem.
the pre training tasks for embedding based large scale retrieval can be divided into 3 groups.
the embedding based retrieval model with pre training tasks is a strong baseline for large scale retrieval tasks, and it is competitive with the state of the art methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Transformer models with pre training tasks can significantly improve the retrieval quality and efficiency.
the embedding based retrieval model with pre training is a viable and promising direction to solve the large scale query-document retrieval problem.
pre training tasks for the Transformer models are critical for large scale retrieval.
